newsitem.title: CHILE: RESEACH ALERT - Copec buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEACH ALERT - Copec buy reiterated.

text.p: Santander Investment raised its target price and earnings estimate on Compania de Petroleos de Chile SA, or Copec, Chile's largest industrial company, with interest in forestry, oil and fishing.

Santander analysts Tracy Evans and Allison Kraver revised Copec's earnings per share estimates to 100, 136.7 and 163.9 Chilean pesos for 1997, 1998 and 1999, respectively, from 87.8, 139.4 and 160.6 pesos.
The slight decline for next year is the result of monetary correction related to the forestry business, they said.
The new 12 to 18 month price target is 2,450 pesos, implying 30 percent upside, said a Santander report.
